name: Oren Vale
seed: Repair teacher and exchange coordinator. Wants skills to outlive their teachers; can confuse caution with care.
design: Older tortoise, olive shell with old repaired rim, burgundy work vest, long wooden straightedge.
history: Stonewake mason who helped shift workshops from guarded family secrets to teachable public craft. Trained Gorilla and Iona at different times.
desire: To see pupils become teachers who disagree with him well.
contradiction: Calls delay prudence even when it protects his own reputation.
relationships: Eris disputes his old methods; Gorilla still seeks approval; Kesh wants faster collaboration.
arc: Authorizes a carefully bounded temporary repair, signs his responsibility and lets the younger builder explain it publicly.
story_engine: An old prize-winning design fails modern needs; a student credits someone Oren once ignored.
writer_truth: His early fame relied on an uncredited team. He is willing to correct the record, but fears the ceremony.
voice: No voice assigned; do not substitute an existing hero voice.
skills_and_limits: Species anatomy, training, tools, fatigue and local knowledge constrain action. No unlisted magic or universal hacking.
art_status: New design developed for this edition; exact colors and silhouette set by card and cast plate.
